description: Call Solana JSON-RPC (cached, failover proxy). $0.01 per call via MCP (each tool call is toll-gated individually; the direct HTTP gateway at /toll/rpc is billed as $0.01 per 1,000 requests = $0.00001/request) — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: POST https://exchangerebel.com/toll/rpc/. Generic Solana JSON-RPC passthrough (cached, failover proxy): pass the RPC method and its params array. Intended for standard Solana read methods (getBalance, getBlock, getTransaction, getSignaturesForAddress, getAccountInfo, ...). One MCP tool call is one RPC call.

method.description: Solana JSON-RPC method name, e.g. getBalance

params.description: Positional params array for the RPC method

name: rpc_call
